name: strongSwan Open Source IPsec VPN
free_limit: GPLv2 open-source IKEv2/IPsec VPN software for self-managed gateways and clients; no per-user, tunnel or bandwidth quota imposed by the free software.
watch_out: Requires your own gateway/server, public connectivity, certificates or authentication, networking and security operations. ISP/cloud bandwidth and infrastructure may cost money. Optional commercial licensing and paid support are separate; GPLv2 conditions apply to redistribution.
